messages.subject: fileInput issue
parts:
Hi,

I have an app that uses fileInput('file1','file:'). When I click "Choose File" and select a file such as 'test.csv', my app does as I would expect. However, if I edit test.csv with an external text editor, then click "Choose File" and and select 'test.csv' again, nothing happens. I suspect it's because input$file1 has not changed.

How may I cause input$file1 to invalidate even when a user picks the same file name?

Jonathan

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Re: fileInput issue
parts:
Hi,

This works for me. Please someone mark as complete, because I'm not able to mark my own post as complete.

I found a combination of these two solutions did the trick:
#  http://stackoverflow.com/questions/17352086/how-can-i-update-an-shiny-fileinput-object
#  http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1043957/clearing-input-type-file-using-jquery

The javascript looks like this:

      tags$script('
        Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("resetFileInputHandler", function(x) {   
          var el = $("#" + x);
          el.replaceWith(el = el.clone(true));
          var id = "#" + x + "_progress";     
          $(id).css("visibility", "hidden");
        });
      ')

ui.R:
fileInput('file1','Howdy')

server.R:
observe({
   input$file1
   # do stuff with file1 here

   Sys.sleep(1)
   session$sendCustomMessage(type = "resetFileInputHandler", 'file1')
})

Jonathan
